checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Non-existent product_uuid on line item must not crash event group creation
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx expected (422 with a numeric code). steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a line item whose product_uuid decodes to an id with no matching active Product.
